disposition.summary: DEP02-B is running thick at 513-515 with all recent lots OOC, while other chambers and clean and metrology tools are normal. FDC sensors are normal, pointing to chamber buildup after 2484 wafers without PM. Hold the alarm lot and the chamber for PM and review.

Alarm lot is high at 513.69 — pulling its history to check the possible causes.
Evidence points to the chamber itself — now verifying with sensor readings.

truth.explanation: DEP02-B is overdue for PM; buildup has pushed deposition up, thickest at the edge.

public: US Patent 6,512,991, Reducing deposition variation by modeling post-clean chamber performance
Material builds up on the chamber's inner surfaces with use and changes the deposition rate.
sources.practitioner: Deposition shows buildup more clearly than etch: material collects inside the chamber and the rate usually rises with it. Fabs compensate by wafer count since PM, which hides most but not all of the drift.
